intuition: Lock ownership is local, while an upgrade only needs to inspect the target's ancestors and descendants.

brute_force.approach: For every operation, scan all tree nodes to discover parent and descendant locks.

optimal.approach: Store child adjacency and lock owners; walk ancestors upward and traverse only the target subtree for upgrades.
optimal.time: lock/unlock O(1), upgrade O(subtree size + height)

edge_cases: Upgrade fails if the target is already locked or an ancestor is locked.
Upgrade requires at least one locked descendant and clears all such locks.
